dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Selamat pagi, dan terima kasih sudah datang untuk wawancara.
dialogue.en: Good morning, and thank you for coming to the interview.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Selamat pagi. Terima kasih sudah mengundang saya.
dialogue.en: Good morning. Thank you for inviting me.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Silakan ceritakan sedikit tentang diri Anda dan pengalaman Anda.
dialogue.en: Please tell me a little about yourself and your experience.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Saya belajar bisnis, dan saya sudah bekerja di bidang pemasaran selama tiga tahun.
dialogue.en: I studied business, and I have worked in marketing for three years.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Menarik. Mengapa Anda melamar posisi ini?
dialogue.en: Interesting. Why did you apply for this position?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Saya menyukai proyek-proyek perusahaan Anda, dan saya ingin belajar dalam tim yang lebih besar.
dialogue.en: I like your company's projects, and I want to learn in a bigger team.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Apa kekuatan terbesar Anda menurut Anda sendiri?
dialogue.en: What would you say is your greatest strength?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Saya teratur dan tetap tenang saat ada tekanan.
dialogue.en: I am organized, and I stay calm when there is pressure.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Apakah Anda lebih suka bekerja sendiri atau dalam tim?
dialogue.en: Do you prefer working alone or as part of a team?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Saya menikmati keduanya, tetapi saya bekerja paling baik dalam tim.
dialogue.en: I enjoy both, but I do my best work in a team.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Baik. Kami akan menghubungi Anda minggu depan. Apakah Anda punya pertanyaan?
dialogue.en: Good. We will contact you next week. Do you have any questions?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ya, bisakah Anda menjelaskan tentang gaji dan jam kerjanya?
dialogue.en: Yes, could you tell me about the salary and the working hours?
